title: MovementResult
description: Structured movement analysis result emitted by the client-side computer vision engine and submitted to the backend.

repetitions.description: Current verified repetition count for the exercise session.

joint_angles.description: Calculated joint angles in degrees (0.0 to 180.0 or 360.0). Missing joints may be omitted or null.

measurement_reliable.description: True if all required landmarks meet confidence/visibility thresholds; false if occluded, out of frame, or noisy.

visibility.description: Landmark visibility confidence scores (0.0 to 1.0) for primary tracked joints.

movement_checks.description: List of qualitative feedback flags detected during movement (e.g., knee_caving, insufficient_depth, rapid_movement, low_visibility).

captured_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of frame capture.
